research_question: Can a piecewise Chebyshev longitude representation satisfy the existing five-body EXP-1 engineering-feasibility gate without live ordinary-runtime network access?

coverage.segment_padding: source collection may extend only to the next full segment boundary for the tested variant; validation scope remains the declared window

representation.longitude_preprocess: unwrap each segment locally before fit; return modulo 360 degrees
representation.fit: ordinary least-squares Chebyshev fit over all 5-day source samples in each segment
representation.speed: analytic derivative of fitted Chebyshev series converted to deg/day
representation.segment_selection: deterministic floor from coverage start; no blending or hidden fallback
representation.artifact_encoding_measurement: float64 coefficient payload, object-major then segment-major

rules: Do not widen thresholds after observing results.
A variant passes only if every frozen gate passes.
Use direct Horizons truth at the existing 12 E2 validation instants; derive truth speed by the existing ±1 hour central difference contract.
Boundary continuity is evaluated between adjacent independently fitted segments for every object.
No production mutation or provider admission follows automatically from feasibility.
If every declared variant fails, the result rejects only this declared Chebyshev candidate family; bounded SPK and other architectures remain separate research.
